questions.label: Current fault
questions.question: Does the equipment currently have a fault requiring repair?
questions.yes: The report describes a current operational defect.
questions.no: The equipment is operating normally; repetition alone is not evidence of a fault.

text:
Forwarded twice: 'motor failed Tuesday'. Current update: new motor fitted Wednesday, all checks passed; it is working normally.
Inspection: The replacement motor is running normally. The Tuesday failure is historical.
